2609.21493.title: PolyBridgeBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Physics-Grounded Bridge Design
2609.21493.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models, or MLLMs, perform well at visual understanding and structured generation, yet these capabilities do not establish whether an engineering design will work when executed. Existing benchmarks assess spatial reasoning, structural validity, or physics-grounded construction, but they do not determine whether MLLMs can synthesize complete load-bearing structures and repair them after simulator execution exposes a failure. We introduce PolyBridgeBench, an executable benchmark for multimodal bridge design. A model receives a visual scene and structured engineering constraints and generates a complete node--member--material topology. Deterministic legality checks gate execution in a native dynamic physics simulation. Following an execution failure, the benchmark returns temporal visual evidence from the failed rollout and evaluates repair under a fixed interaction budget. Separate measurements of deterministic validity, dynamic functional success, and post-failure recovery identify the stage at which design fails. Experiments with six representative MLLMs across 189 levels expose a substantial gap between deterministic validity and dynamic success, pronounced sensitivity to material budgets, and limited post-failure recovery under the primary strict-budget setting.
2609.21493.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型，或稱 MLLMs，在視覺理解和結構生成方面表現良好，但這些能力並不能確定工程設計在執行時是否有效。現有的基準評估空間推理、結構有效性或基於物理的建設，但它們並未確定 MLLMs 是否能合成完整的承載結構，並在模擬執行暴露出失敗後進行修復。我們介紹了 PolyBridgeBench，一個可執行的多模態橋樑設計基準。模型接收視覺場景和結構工程約束，並生成完整的節點-成員-材料拓撲。確定性合法性檢查在本地動態物理模擬中控制執行。在執行失敗後，基準返回失敗展開的時間視覺證據，並在固定的互動預算下評估修復。確定性有效性、動態功能成功和失敗後恢復的單獨測量確定設計失敗的階段。對六個代表性 MLLMs 在 189 個層級的實驗揭示了確定性有效性和動態成功之間的重大差距，對材料預算的顯著敏感性，以及在主要嚴格預算設置下有限的失敗後恢復能力。
